topic: Can MVDR beamforming sufficiently compensate for pattern degradation in array-fed reflectors during element failures?
consensus_response: MVDR beamforming can mitigate pattern degradation, but its effectiveness is limited by array factor, interference, and SNR. Defocused reflectors increase vulnerability to border element failures. Optimizing reflector surface and feed array design can improve performance under failure conditions by minimizing defocusing effects and reducing gain loss.
reference_context: Defocused reflector systems experience gain roll-off towards borders, increasing vulnerability to element failures, but MVDR beamforming can help mitigate pattern degradation.
